create_PseudoBBoxCoder: create a PseudoBBoxCoder instance to pass ground truth bboxes through without encoding
encode_PseudoBBoxCoder: encode ground truth bboxes using PseudoBBoxCoder which returns them unchanged as a tensor
decode_PseudoBBoxCoder: decode predicted bboxes using PseudoBBoxCoder returning them as HorizontalBoxes or raw tensor
review_PseudoBBoxCoder_class: review the PseudoBBoxCoder class and its encode and decode methods for pass-through behavior
test_PseudoBBoxCoder: test the PseudoBBoxCoder encode and decode methods with sample bbox tensors
